props.study_text:
A playful spirit of the wind that toys with grounded travelers. It avoids direct fights, preferring to twist the flow of battle with tricks and sudden gusts.

Knock it down or force it to fight fair—if you let it control the wind, it will control the turn order.
props.tactic_notes: Highly evasive; fights from the air with Flying mobility. Opens by empowering allies or hindering grounded foes (look for Tailwind causing Swift / Slow swings). Uses Gust (Air) to disrupt tempo with Delay. Sprinkles annoying status effects: Pixie Flash (Light) may inflict Blind, and Paralysis Pollen threatens Paralyzed. If pressured, it may vanish into Invisibility and become Hidden to stall.
